title: isolate preflight machinery into subchart and add optional migration hooks
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Breaks out preflight checks into a separate subchart, introduces a feature-flagged optional migration hook set and adds annotations to support drift detection. No user-facing API changes expected; operators using custom hooks should review values migrations.
description:
Context: Private installs have accumulated preflight tasks (k8s checks, secret bootstrap, certificate sanity) inline inside the main chart templates. This made the main chart harder to reason about, caused delays during chart rendering and complicated selective upgrades. We also received a support ticket (SUP-918) where an automated tenant migration hook triggered unexpectedly during a maintenance window. This PR separates the preflight machinery into a dedicated subchart and makes the migration hooks opt-in via values flags so operators can enable them explicitly.

What this PR does: 1) Moves preflight templates (preflight-check, preflight-cronjob, preflight-rbac) into charts/preflight-subchart and exposes a minimal values schema to control behavior; 2) Adds boolean flags values.preflight.enabled and values.preflight.runOnce to support running checks as an init-only job vs. a cron; 3) Introduces values.migrationHooks.enabled and values.migrationHooks.mode to allow opt-in migration hooks with modes: disabled / canary / primary; 4) Adds annotations and labels to init jobs to support external drift-detection tooling (runnable via the SRE operator); 5) Improves idempotency and wait logic in the init job container (retries, exponential backoff, clearer logs).

Migration notes: The top-level values previously named preflight* are consolidated under values.preflight. A small shim in values.schema.json maps old keys so existing installs will not fail but operators are encouraged to move to the new keys in their values.yaml. Operators using custom migration hooks should set values.migrationHooks.enabled=false during the upgrade, verify behavior, then opt-in.

Testing: Helm lint + unit templates, local k8s (kind) install test, and the private-installer e2e harness targeted at upgrade paths. I ran an upgrade from 2026.01 to 2026.02 in a staging cluster with tenant-scoped installs and validated that preflight jobs executed once when runOnce=true and that migration hooks did not run when disabled.

Why this is safe: The behavior preserves defaults (preflight enabled) but isolates implementation. Migration hooks are opt-in by default. A shim preserves legacy values so existing automation continues to work.

Follow-ups: 1) Add an operator guide page that documents values.preflight.* and values.migrationHooks.*; 2) Wire the chart to the console's rollout controller to expose preflight health in the UI; 3) Add a lightweight smoke-test that verifies migration hook gating during upgrades.
commits: refactor(chart): move preflight manifests into charts/preflight-subchart
fix(init): make init job idempotent with backoff and clearer logging
test: add helm unit tests and kind upgrade path test
diff_snippets: charts/preflight-subchart/templates/preflight-job.yaml: replaced inline job with subchartJob; added annotations: 'redwood.io/drift-detection: "enabled"'
charts/redwood/templates/hooks/_migration-hook.yaml: wrapped hook manifest with 'if .Values.migrationHooks.enabled' and conditional mode check for canary/primary
review_comments: Daniel Kim: Can you add a short section in values.schema.json explaining runOnce semantics? Right now it's ambiguous whether runOnce=true turns cron off or runs one immediate job.
Author (Aisha): runOnce=true now sets cron.enabled=false and creates a single job via helm hook with hook-weight 0 — added explanation to values.schema.json and example in staging-values.yaml.
Sanjay Rao: The init job backoff logic looks good. Please ensure logs include a deterministic prefix so the release controller can grep for success/failure status.
Author (Aisha): added 'preflight:' log prefix and bumped unit tests to assert on it.
Marta Lopez: Tests flaked once on CI — looks like the kind cluster ran out of disk. Re-run CI after test fix. Approved after CI green.
post_merge_actions: Docs: create a quickstart page for the preflight subchart explaining runOnce vs cron
Ops: coordinate with SRE to add drift-detection annotations to the console collector
Backport: assess whether to backport shim to v2026.01 for high-risk tenants
notes_for_operators: Legacy keys are shims; prefer values.preflight.* going forward
Migration hooks default to disabled; enable with values.migrationHooks.enabled=true and choose mode (canary|primary)
When performing upgrades, set migrationHooks.enabled=false until you have validated in staging
changelog_entry: Refactor: preflight checks moved to a dedicated subchart and migration hooks made opt-in. Adds annotations for drift detection and improves init job idempotency (operators: review values.preflight.* and values.migrationHooks.*).
